tier_should.rationale: Combines lab and field to identify willful-ignorance effects using randomized VR information and pre-registration. Heterogeneity by WTP is novel and policy-relevant. Short-lived effects and student sample limit external validity. Suitable for strong field journals in behavioral/applied economics.

tier_will.rationale: Solid execution and timely topic, but modest novelty and transient effects reduce headline appeal. Likely fit for reputable field outlets (JEEM, JEBO, Experimental Economics) rather than A-journals.
